data.name: AppName_Elevated
data.comment: First line of the tray tooltip while the app runs as administrator. The whole tooltip must stay under 128 characters.

data.name: Key_Ctrl
data.comment: Modifier key names in shortcuts such as "Ctrl + S": as printed on keyboards in that language

data.name: Key_Delete
data.comment: Names of special keys in shortcuts such as "Ctrl + Del": as printed on keyboards in that language. Letters and symbols come from the keyboard layout instead.

data.name: Hotkeys_Section_Global_Description
data.value: Work in any program, also while you're playing. Off until you set one.

data.name: Hotkeys_TogglePause_Description
data.value: Turns detection off or on, like the tray menu.

data.name: Hotkeys_AddForegroundGame
data.value: Add the game in the foreground

data.name: Hotkeys_AddForegroundGame_Description
data.value: Adds the program you're using to the games and makes it borderless right away, unless detection is paused. A sound tells you whether it was added.

data.name: Hotkeys_Save_Description
data.value: Saves the changes in this window.

data.name: Hotkeys_RemoveGame_Description
data.value: Works while the games list has the focus.

data.name: Hotkeys_Box_Hint
data.value: Click here and press a key combination

data.name: Hotkeys_Error_NeedsModifier
data.value: Combine it with Ctrl, Alt or Win, or use an F key.

data.name: Hotkeys_Error_NavigationKey
data.value: The games list needs this key for moving around. Choose a different one.

data.name: Hotkeys_Error_Invalid
data.value: This key can't be used as a hotkey.

data.name: Hotkeys_Error_Duplicate
data.comment: {0} = the other hotkey's name, e.g. "Save settings"

data.name: Hotkeys_RegistrationFailedOne
data.value: {0} doesn't work: another program probably already uses this combination. Choose a different one.

data.name: Hotkeys_RegistrationFailedMany
data.value: These hotkeys don't work: {0}. Other programs probably already use these combinations. Choose different ones.

data.name: Hotkeys_Warning_InUse
data.value: Another program is using this combination right now, so it wouldn't work. Choose a different one if you can.

data.name: Hotkeys_Warning_CommonShortcut
data.value: Many programs use this combination themselves. As a global hotkey, it no longer reaches any of them.

data.name: Hotkeys_Section_Global_Limits
data.value: Only hotkeys that other programs register with Windows can be checked. A game's own key bindings and tools that read the keyboard directly (some macro tools and overlays) aren't detected. While a hotkey is set here, the program in the foreground usually no longer receives that combination.

data.name: Error_Unexpected_Message
data.value: An unexpected error occurred. Details have been written to the log file.

data.name: SettingsWindow_TitleElevated
data.comment: Window title while the app runs as administrator. Same "Administrator: " prefix Windows uses (Command Prompt, PowerShell)

data.name: Settings_RestartRequired
data.value: Restart the app to apply the language change.

data.name: Placement_AutomaticPreview
data.comment: {0} = width, {1} = height, {2} = horizontal offset, all in pixels; {3} = the display's short name (Placement_Display_*Short or the monitor name), like in Placement_Summary_WithDisplay

data.name: Placement_AlignLeft_Tooltip
data.value: Set the offset so the window touches the left edge of the display

data.name: Placement_AlignRight_Tooltip
data.value: Set the offset so the window touches the right edge of the display

data.name: Placement_CenterX_Tooltip
data.value: Set the offset so the window is centered horizontally on the display

data.name: Games_Error_MissingExe
data.value: {0}: enter the name of the program file.

data.name: Games_Error_DuplicateExe
data.value: {0} and {1} use the same program file and the same filters.

data.name: Settings_UnsavedChanges_Message
data.value: Your changes will be lost if you don't save them.

data.name: Placement_Error_WidthTooLarge
data.value: Wider than the display: at most {0} px.

data.name: Placement_Error_HeightTooLarge
data.value: Taller than the display: at most {0} px.

data.name: Placement_Error_OffsetTooLarge
data.value: Too far right for this width: at most {0} px.

data.name: Games_Status_RunningOff
data.value: Running – turned off for this game

data.name: Games_Status_NoFrame
data.value: Running – no frame, left as it is

data.name: Games_Status_FightPaused
data.value: Running – the game keeps resetting its window

data.name: Games_Status_AccessDenied
data.value: Windows denied access – the game probably runs as administrator

data.name: Games_Problem_NoFrame
data.value: The game’s window already has no frame: it’s in fullscreen or in the game’s own borderless mode, so it’s left as it is. To use the size and position from here instead, switch the game to windowed mode in its settings.

data.name: Games_Problem_FightPaused
data.value: Trying again shortly. If this keeps happening, check the game’s display settings.

data.name: Games_Problem_Failed
data.value: The game’s window could not be changed. Details are in the log (tray menu → Troubleshooting → Open log folder).

data.name: Games_Problem_AccessDenied
data.value: Windows doesn’t allow changing this game’s window. Usually that means the game runs as administrator: Windows then only allows changes if Force Borderless Windowed runs as administrator too. Start this app as administrator, or start the game without administrator rights.

data.name: Games_Problem_AccessDeniedElevated
data.value: Windows doesn’t allow changing this game’s window, even though Force Borderless Windowed runs as administrator. The game is probably protected, e.g. by anti-cheat software.

data.name: Games_LockCursor
data.value: Keep the mouse inside the game window

data.name: Games_LockCursor_Hint
data.value: Only while the game is in the foreground. Alt+Tab or the Windows key release the mouse.

data.name: Games_HideTaskbar_Hint
data.value: Only while the game is in the foreground, and only on the game’s display.

data.name: Settings_StartAsAdmin_Hint
data.value: Only needed for games that run as administrator. Copies the app to the Program Files folder, where only administrators can change it, and starts that copy without a UAC prompt when you sign in. Turning it on or off asks for administrator permission once.

data.name: Settings_StartAsAdmin_NeedsAutostart
data.comment: Put in front of Settings_StartAsAdmin_Hint while "Start with Windows" is off

data.name: Settings_StartAsAdmin_NotAdmin
data.value: Not available: your Windows account isn’t an administrator, so the app would start with normal rights anyway.

data.name: Settings_LoadFailed_Title
data.value: Your settings file couldn’t be read

data.name: Settings_LoadFailed_BackedUp
data.value: The default settings are shown instead. The old file was kept as {0} in the settings folder, so nothing is lost when you save.

data.name: Settings_LoadFailed_NotBackedUp
data.value: The default settings are shown instead, and a copy of the old file couldn’t be made. Saving tries the copy again first and leaves the old file alone until that works.

data.name: Settings_PausedHint
data.value: Detection is paused: game windows keep their normal frame.

data.name: Settings_PauseDetection_Description
data.value: While paused, game windows get their frame and position back. Resuming makes them borderless again. Applies immediately, like in the tray menu.

data.name: Games_RestartAsAdmin_Tooltip
data.value: Restarts Force Borderless Windowed with administrator rights. Save your changes first.

data.name: Settings_Theme_Description
data.value: Light, dark, or the same as Windows

data.name: Settings_StartWithWindows_Description
data.value: Runs in the notification area when you sign in

data.name: Games_Empty_Message
data.value: Start a game in windowed mode, add it here, then select Save & apply. From then on it is made borderless every time it runs.

data.name: Games_Status_NoMatchingTitle
data.value: Running – no window with a matching title

data.name: Games_Error_MissingExe_Field
data.value: Enter the name of the program file, e.g. game.exe.

data.name: Games_Error_DuplicateExe_Field
data.value: {0} already uses this program file. To keep both, set “Only this exe file” or a window title on one of them.

data.name: Games_Error_ExeNotFileName_Field
data.value: Enter only the name of the program file, e.g. game.exe, without a folder.

data.name: Games_Error_ExeNotFileName
data.value: {0}: enter only the name of the program file, not a path.

data.name: Hotkeys_Box_Recording
data.value: Press the key combination now. Tab moves on, Ctrl⁠+⁠Tab switches tabs: those can’t be recorded.

data.name: Settings_AutostartNotChanged
data.value: Start with Windows wasn't changed: administrator permission was declined, or the change didn't finish.

data.name: Settings_AutostartNotChanged_OthersSaved
data.value: Your other settings were saved. Start with Windows wasn't changed: administrator permission was declined, or the change didn't finish.

data.name: Settings_AutostartInUse
data.value: Start with Windows wasn't changed: the app's copy in Program Files is running for another Windows user on this PC, so it can't be replaced. Try again once they've closed it.

data.name: Settings_AutostartInUse_OthersSaved
data.value: Your other settings were saved. Start with Windows wasn't changed: the app's copy in Program Files is running for another Windows user on this PC, so it can't be replaced. Try again once they've closed it.

data.name: Settings_AdminCopyOutdated
data.value: At sign-in, Windows still starts an older version of the app with administrator rights. Update it to this version.

data.name: Settings_AdminCopyNotUpdated
data.value: Not updated: administrator permission was declined, or the update didn't finish.

data.name: Settings_AdminCopyInUse
data.value: Not updated: the app's copy in Program Files is running for another Windows user on this PC, so it can't be replaced. Try again once they've closed it.

data.name: Games_Status_NotResponding
data.value: Running – waiting, the game isn’t responding

data.name: Games_Problem_NotResponding
data.value: Windows reports the game as not responding, usually while it loads. Its window is changed as soon as it responds again.

data.name: Games_MatchExecutablePath_NoPath
data.value: Choose the file with Browse… to use this.

data.name: Games_WindowTitleContains_Hint
data.value: Leave empty for every window of the program. Useful when several games share one exe, e.g. javaw.exe.

data.name: Placement_GameSize_Hint
data.value: Removes the frame and keeps the size the game sets. Follows a resolution you change in the game.

data.name: Hotkeys_ApplyToForeground
data.value: Make the window in the foreground borderless

data.name: Hotkeys_ApplyToForeground_Description
data.value: Temporary: makes the window you’re using borderless with the default placement. Nothing is saved and the program isn’t added to the games. It lasts until the window closes, detection is paused or the app exits; press again to put the window back right away. A sound tells you whether it worked.

data.name: Games_BlackBackground_Hint
data.value: Covers the rest of the game’s display in black while the game is in the foreground. The taskbar stays on top: turn on “Hide the taskbar” too for a fully black screen.

data.name: Placement_ShowOnDisplay_Tooltip
data.value: Shows for a few seconds, on the display itself, where the game window will be.

data.name: Placement_ShowOnDisplay_NeedsGame
data.value: Start the game to show its own size.

data.name: Overlay_AddedPaused
data.value: Added {0} to Games – detection is paused

data.name: Overlay_NoProgram
data.value: This window can’t be used (desktop or a Windows program)

data.name: Overlay_OneOffNoFrame
data.value: {0} has no frame (fullscreen?), left as it is

data.name: Overlay_OneOffAccessDenied
data.value: Windows denied access – {0} probably runs as administrator

data.name: Overlay_OneOffFailed
data.value: {0}: the window couldn’t be changed (details in the log)

data.name: Overlay_OneOffPaused
data.value: Detection is paused: {0} stays as it is

data.name: Overlay_Paused
data.value: Detection paused – game windows put back

data.name: Hotkeys_ShowMessages
data.value: Show a message over the game

data.name: Hotkeys_ShowMessages_Description
data.value: When a global hotkey is pressed: a short note over the game. Not shown over games in exclusive fullscreen.

data.name: Placement_KeepAspectRatio
data.value: Keep the shape on narrower displays (bars top and bottom)

data.name: Placement_Warning_DoesNotFit
data.value: Larger than this display ({0} × {1}): the game window is shrunk to fit.

data.name: Hotkeys_PlaySounds_Description
data.value: When a global hotkey is pressed: the Windows notification sound if it worked, the error sound if it wasn’t possible. Uses your Windows sound settings.
